## What changed from visualizer 1

visualizer 1 kept every pane root in \`viewof visualizers\` and one \`syncers\` cell reconciled all of them against \`liveCellMap\`, holding each observer's cleanup in hand-kept Maps. visualizer 2 is built with [dataflow templating](https://observablehq.com/@tomlarkworthy/dataflow-templating):

- A pane is an \`instantiateDataflow\` instance of the pane template (\`vizPaneTemplate\`), parameterised by its root, module, filter and inspector.
- Each drawn cell is an instance of the cell template (\`vizCellTemplate\`), parameterised by its variable. Its observation is released through the instance's \`invalidation\`, so deleting a cell or disposing a pane is \`instance.dispose()\`.
- Instances live in the sandbox Runtime, so the page runtime gains no variables per pane or per cell.

Two further changes:

- Cells come from [cell-map-2](https://observablehq.com/@tomlarkworthy/cell-map-2), which groups notebook-kit variables (\`cell N\`, \`viewof$x\`, projections) as well as classic ones.
- A cell defined by [js-toolchain](https://observablehq.com/@tomlarkworthy/js-toolchain)'s \`defineCell\` renders its notebook-kit display root, attached once through \`attachDisplay\`, so \`display()\` called twice shows two nodes. Other cells render through the inspector as before.

Not handled yet: a template edit reaches new panes and cells but not the nodes already mounted.

## How panes are built

A pane is an \`instantiateDataflow\` instance of \`vizPaneTemplate\`, parameterised by its root, module, filter and inspector. Each drawn cell is an instance of \`vizCellTemplate\`, parameterised by its variable. A cell's observer is released through its instance's \`invalidation\`, so deleting a cell or disposing a pane is \`instance.dispose()\`. Instances live in [dataflow templating](https://observablehq.com/@tomlarkworthy/dataflow-templating)'s sandbox Runtime, so the page runtime gains no variables per pane or per cell.

\`vizPaneCells\` reads [cell-map](https://observablehq.com/@tomlarkworthy/cell-map)'s \`liveCellMap\`, which groups Notebook Kit variables (\`cell N\`, \`viewof$x\`, projections) as well as classic ones.

A cell defined by [js-toolchain](https://observablehq.com/@tomlarkworthy/js-toolchain)'s \`defineCell\` renders its Notebook Kit display root, attached once through js-toolchain's \`attachDisplay\`, so \`display()\` called twice shows two nodes. Other cells render through the inspector.

\`syncers\` is \`vizSynced\`, the count of pane syncs; editor-5 reads it as a trigger.

A template edit reaches panes and cells created after it, not nodes already mounted.

### Templates

Parameter cells hold the defaults the template cells compute with in this module, where no instance supplies them; each template cell returns early without its parameters.

### Templates

\`vizVariable\`, \`vizInspector\`, \`vizDetachNodes\`, \`vizRoot\`, \`vizModule\` and \`vizFilter\` are the templates' parameters, supplied by each instance. In this module they hold defaults (\`null\`, \`false\`, \`() => true\`), and \`vizCellNode\` returns \`null\` without a variable and an inspector.

## Tests

Behavioural tests for \`visualizer()\`, written 2026-09-13 so the original's behaviour is pinned before visualizer-2 is merged into it (T3 in \`plan/merging-the-notebook-kit-forks.md\`).

Each \`test_viz_*\` cell makes a throwaway module with runtime-sdk's \`createModule\`, mounts \`visualizer(runtime, options)\` on it in an off-screen host, changes the module's variables, and waits for the DOM to follow. The tests read only what \`visualizer()\` returns, so the same cells can run against visualizer-2. Everything a test creates is deleted in \`finally\`.

A fixture's first cell is a \`title\` string. \`@tomlarkworthy/modules\` computes a module's first cell to find its title, so without it the first cell under test would run before any visualizer observed it. Title cells, implicit builtin variables (\`Generators\`, \`@variable\`) and the builtin import header are left out of the names the tests compare.

**Gate.** Each test resolves to a \`skipped:\` string until *Run visualizer tests* is on. Add \`&viz_tests\` to the hash to start with it on.
